groups.title: Straw Hat Pirates
groups.def: Every official member of the Straw Hat crew as of the anime (through Elbaph).

groups.title: Warlords of the Sea
groups.def: Every pirate who held a Seven Warlords of the Sea position before the system's abolition, shown in the anime.

groups.title: Four Emperors
groups.def: Every pirate who has held the title of Yonko (Emperor) in the anime, old or current lineup.

groups.title: Marines
groups.def: Characters who are or were commissioned officers of the Marines shown in the anime.

groups.title: Fish-Man Island natives
groups.def: Fish-Men or Merfolk from Fish-Man Island appearing in the anime.

groups.title: Giants
groups.def: Members of the Giant race who appear in the anime.

groups.title: Beasts Pirates
groups.def: The captain, All-Stars, and Tobiroppo officers of Kaido's Beasts Pirates crew shown in the anime, including the defected Drake.

groups.title: Marine Admirals
groups.def: Every character shown holding the Marine rank of Admiral or Fleet Admiral in the anime.

groups.title: Vinsmoke Family
groups.def: Members of the royal Vinsmoke family of Germa 66 shown in the anime, including Sanji.

groups.title: Kozuki Family
groups.def: Members of Wano's ruling Kozuki clan shown in the anime, by blood or marriage.

groups.title: Revolutionary Army
groups.def: Leaders of the Revolutionary Army shown in the anime.

groups.title: CP9
groups.def: The Rokushiki-trained secret assassins of Cipher Pol No. 9 who fought the Straw Hats at Water 7 and Enies Lobby, not counting their chief Spandam.

groups.title: Baroque Works
groups.def: Alabasta-arc characters unmasked as Baroque Works agents in the anime (Vivi infiltrated it undercover as its princess).

groups.title: Logia users
groups.def: Characters shown using a Logia-type Devil Fruit in the anime.

groups.title: Worst Generation
groups.def: The twelve pirates - the eleven rookies whose bounties topped 100 million berries at Sabaody, plus the then-Warlord Blackbeard - collectively named the Worst Generation.

groups.title: Roger Pirates
groups.def: Confirmed crew of Gol D. Roger's ship shown in the anime, including Kozuki Oden's several-year stint aboard.

groups.title: The Gorosei
groups.def: The five current Elders who lead the World Government, named in the anime.

groups.title: Mythical Zoan users
groups.def: Characters shown using a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit in the anime.

groups.title: Zoan users
groups.def: Characters shown using a standard or Ancient Zoan-type Devil Fruit (not Mythical Zoan) in the anime.

groups.title: Tobiroppo
groups.def: The six strongest Shinuchi officers of the Beasts Pirates, collectively called the Tobiroppo, including the defected Drake.

groups.title: Died in the anime
groups.def: Characters whose deaths are shown or confirmed on-screen in the anime.

groups.title: Will of the D.
groups.def: Characters confirmed in the anime to carry the middle initial D., the mysterious "Will of D."

groups.title: Names that are English words
groups.def: The short display name is, on its own, an ordinary English dictionary word (Robin, Law, Brook, Shanks, Roger, Dragon…). Proper nouns (Mars, Saturn, Loki) and phrases (Big Mom, Page One, Who's-Who) don't count.
